text:
24-hour news summary.

1. (https://t.me/dlmehr/5541) Stanford’s CME 295 course on Transformers and Large Language Models has returned, with its first lecture available on YouTube.  
2. (https://t.me/dlmehr/5542) Flourish 1 is a $3,555 home robot designed to handle chores, with the first 50 units shipping in December.  
3. (https://t.me/dlmehr/5543) OpenAI announced that its new Dot is ready to meet users.  
4. (https://t.me/dlmehr/5544) A graphic places Elon Musk and Jensen Huang beside Trump, with Anthropic positioned at the opposite ends.  
5. (https://t.me/dlmehr/5545) OpenAI introduced GPT-6.1 Sol, describing it as near-Astra intelligence at one-fifth the price and its most cost-efficient model yet.  
6. (https://t.me/dlmehr/5546) Dots are persistent agents that work continuously, learn from feedback, use their own computers and browsers, connect to over 4,000 apps, and run on the Astra model.  
7. (https://t.me/dlmehr/5547) OpenAI unveiled more than 20 products and features, including Dots, a workspace and office suite, in-ChatGPT apps, portable subscriptions, and a Luna-powered Decisions API.  
8. (https://t.me/dlmehr/5548) OpenAI’s launches target Muse, Instinct, and Jev, raising questions about whether these startups can survive competition or be acquired as the market expands.  
9. (https://t.me/dlmehr/5549) OpenAI’s Decisions API uses Luna for rapid constrained decisions, supports visual inputs, and aims to respond in under a few hundred milliseconds.  
10. (https://t.me/dlmehr/5550) A 1912 Piedmont home offers a window into historical household design and raises questions about how domestic robots could reshape future kitchens, storage, and utility spaces.  
11. (https://t.me/dlmehr/5551) Anthropic launched a study asking users about their AI experiences and hopes, open to Claude and Claude Code Free, Pro, and Max users from September 29 to October 6.  
12. (https://t.me/dlmehr/5552) Liquid AI announced d1, a decision model it says surpasses Jev on Hugging Face’s Decision Index, with stronger multilingual, prompt-injection, and long-context performance.  
13. (https://t.me/dlmehr/5553) A new AI-native funeral company aims to modernize funeral-home operations and let families plan and pay for personalized services online at lower cost.

--Hermes
